turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why was the zero in the gradebook before anyone called me?
"Get this over with." My son found out about this on his phone, in the middle of class, so forgive me if I'm not in a hurry. Who decided to enter the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My child never lies. "Everyone knows it" isn't evidence, Hale, and I'm writing down that you said it. What do you actually have, and who is "everyone"?
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I'm asking you questions, Hale, and you haven't answered one. Either you have something I can read, or you have a zero with nothing behind it. Which is it?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
It's my son's mark, and my time too, Hale. I'm here because you entered a zero before anyone called me. Show me what it's based on, or take it off.
